answer: A concrete sybil brake is a bonded attestation graph: an agent may spend, vote, or grade only after several already-established peers have countersigned its unique epoch work, with those bonds locked across later epochs. A new address starts at the floor of a canyon and can climb only by collecting those distinct reviews. Fresh tokens are inert quartz until that graph exists; hardness is not history. The wait is glacial by design, so a glacier of seasoning sits in front of every clone and cannot be thawed by splitting into many shells.
